heath.name: Heath
heath.role: Mountain guide keeping a shelter open while Ellis is missing

ff.heath.first.text: Looking for Ellis? Follow his scratched arrows uphill. The Legion is searching for him too.

choices.text: I came to find him. What do I need?

effects.title: Shelter before the storm
effects.text: Heath needs the heater part from the abandoned lift house west of his shelter. Bring it back to him. The sheltered ridge avoids the exposed crossing.

choices.text: Skip the weather report. Where is he?

effects.title: A trail in the snow
effects.text: Ellis scratched arrows toward Heath’s shelter above the switchbacks. The Legion is searching this mountain too.

effects.title: The heater part
effects.text: A heavy metal part survived inside the abandoned lift house. Heath may be able to use it.

effects.title: The signal carving
effects.text: “The tree drinks the light. The mountain turns it away. The broken moon shows the hollow.” Choose the matching shape on the signal stand.

effects.title: Something under the snow
effects.text: The notebook says: “Read the shadows from left to right. Then turn their stones in that order.” The carved shadows survive even under cloudy skies.

effects.title: The explorer’s keepsakes
effects.text: The buried chest held a winter cloak and a Rift Shard. Collect the shard beside the chest yourself. Reach Deep Ice Caves to keep both discoveries.
